column1: # Core set of Salmonella Typhimurium genes required for intestinal colonisation,
# reproduced from Chaudhuri RR et al. (2013) PLoS Genet 9:e1003456, PMID 23637626.
# Definition is the AUTHORS' own: a gene significantly attenuated by transposon-directed
# insertion-site sequencing after ORAL challenge in ALL THREE host species assayed
# (chicken, pig, cattle). The published core set is 611 genes; 591 resolve to an SL1344
# coding sequence in this assembly (584 by the paper's own insertion coordinate, 6 by
# gene symbol, 1 by both), 20 do not resolve and are omitted.
# The paper publishes no per-gene fold change for the core set, so this table supplies an
# attenuation CALL and the source's own TOP ordinal category, never a magnitude.
